## Scope
- [ ] Scope is focused and unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] Existing NexHaat behavior and established 3D visual design are preserved unless the PR explicitly changes them.

## Architecture and data
- [ ] API/schema/database/event contracts were reviewed.
- [ ] Migration, compatibility, and rollback implications are documented.
- [ ] Customer, seller, and admin data isolation was considered.
- [ ] Financial, inventory, payment, and order invariants were preserved.

## Security and privacy
- [ ] Server-side authentication and authorization are enforced.
- [ ] Inputs, outputs, uploads, webhooks, and external tool calls are validated.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or unnecessary personal data are included.
- [ ] Logs and artifacts do not expose sensitive information.

## Quality
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration/E2E tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Relevant lint, type-check, and build checks passed.
- [ ] Accessibility, responsive behavior, and reduced-motion behavior were considered.
- [ ] Performance impact was considered for heavy UI, queries, and network calls.

## Operations
- [ ] CI and security workflow results were reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment, monitoring, and rollback impact is documented.
- [ ] Required documentation/runbooks were updated.
